report.summary: A bare panel now joins free4all (password 'password') by default, same rule as the broker default — stored settings always override, and boot never depends on that network being present. Builds at 2.94 MB, 20 % free.
decisions: Applied the Wi-Fi default in the same place and with the same rule as the broker default: only when nothing is stored (fresh flash or after a factory reset), so a network saved from /settings or `mqtt-wifi` always wins. This keeps the panel's commissioning story intact while making a bare unit join free4all on its own.

With Wi-Fi now present by default, app_mqtt_wifi_missing() is false on a fresh panel, so the onboarding SoftAP is not started at boot — a BOOT long press still opens it, and a factory reset brings the default network back rather than leaving the board unreachable.
report.build: esp32s31 success — 0x2cccb0 (2935984 B) in a 0x380000 partition, 20% free; check_code clean

findingsAddressed.fix: HEATING_DEFAULT_WIFI_SSID/PASS applied in mqtt_load_config() when no SSID is stored, logged as "no Wi-Fi saved — default 'free4all'" so the boot log shows which network was dialled

openQuestions: The credentials are compiled into the image (as requested) and therefore present in any build shipped from this tree; the settings page or `mqtt-wifi` replaces them without a rebuild.
If 'free4all' is out of range at boot the panel stays on the dashboard and retries every 30 s; a BOOT long press opens the onboarding AP for a different network.
